findings.summary: Dawn render-capture JSON bypassed the shared continuation/drain gate used by screenshots and SDL; every Dawn capture now uses capture_ready

generation-time Record snapshots re-expanded effectful texture RHS expressions; static Record entries now read the exact runtime Map value already stored, reducing Scene 66 from 16 loads to 8 and Scene 72 from 22 to 11

explicitly typed record arrays were reclassified as tuples to retain Scene 66 metadata, breaking ordinary push, indexed writes, nested arrays, and object identity; runtime arrays now retain a separate complete staticElements snapshot

static array and Record facts were path-insensitive and array ownership was lost through ordinary aliases; aliases now share one root snapshot and runtime branches, loops, callbacks, switches, and conditional expressions invalidate rather than extend it

generalized snapshots conflated exact data arrays with conservative handle reach sets, dropping shader metadata for generation-known handles pushed inside runtime loops; complete data snapshots still invalidate while proven handle reachability is retained

plain-data snapshots kept pre-storage literal expressions, so later mutations emitted assignments to false and 0.0; stored facts now retain static metadata while rebasing their writable leaf to the actual native array slot
ribbon and tube Vec3 path consumers only understood tuple rows and plain records; they now reuse complete static snapshots and the same validated Vec3 conversion for typed data structs
SDL rebuilt and streamed draw lists for every historical frame task after live topology replacement; it now clears retired rows and rebuilds only scene.tasks

compressed JSON promise transforms built a full Value tree only to clone and rebuild it; the proven chain now decodes raw JSON, restores aliases, and constructs Value once with the real diagnostic node

compressed helper recognition trusted substring regexes and could erase extra observable behavior; exact AST and dataflow checks now prove statement counts, built-ins, guards, assignments, and return identity

runtime indexed-string Values were rejected by the generic known-value sink despite already carrying the correct native string expression; string sinks now accept that existing representation directly

static nullish selection treated explicit JSON null as a winning left arm and materialized record reads widened exact booleans; nullish folding now respects JSON null and property reads prefer retained exact snapshots

continue handling used only static-unroll depth and misclassified continues targeting nested native loops; it now resolves the nearest enclosing iteration against the exact set of source loops being unrolled
ESM and PCF caster composition duplicated the safety-critical shared-binding signature; one nodeSharedBindings extractor and compatibility assertion now serve both

node caster state allowed contradictory nullable ESM/PCF fields and gave PCF a fake parameter binding; it is now a discriminated caster union and composeNodeMaterial uses named options instead of six positional arguments

node-material texture records store a FileTexture or PixelsTexture variant but the runtime boundary accepted neither the variant nor raw pixels; shared StoredTexture dispatch now normalizes pixel metadata and visits the exact alternative
scene light identity used parallel value/kind arrays and unresolved generators silently targeted slot zero; ordered light entries are atomic and unresolved generator slots use a refusing sentinel

scene light removal keyed topology by compiler Value object identity, so aliases left stale manifests and generator slots; light factories now allocate a stable shared identity carrying compacted scene and generator slots

mesh_membership_version also invalidated light and shadow state while comments still described PCF as lacking a second module; names and documentation now describe render topology and both caster modules accurately

focused tests accepted arbitrary groups of duplicate texture loads and retained assertions invalidated by stronger static folding; they now require one load per binding and assert the intended folded/runtime semantics
retired shadow generators still retain engine task/target/view records, and caster MaterialRecord copies retain encoded texture payloads
findings.blockedBy: safe slot reuse needs generation-checked handles, and dropping copied texture payloads needs caster GPU binding to resolve through source_material
